info.name: Missing Cookie SameSite Strict
author: lucky0x0d
PulseSecurity.co.nz
info.description: Identified cookies that lacked the samesite=strict attribute, which prevented enforcement of restrictions on cross-domain cookie transmission.

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/42.0.2311.135 Safari/537.36 Edge/12.10240
Connection: close
Accept: */*
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 06:20:22 GMT
Server: nginx
Set-Cookie: session=abc123def; path=/; HttpOnly

<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>app.example.com</body></html>
